newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher, specs cover shorts.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher, specs cover shorts.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed near the day's highs, buoyed by speculative shortcovering ahead of the holiday, dealers said.
The spot-March contract settled over resistance at 10.71.
"It was another day of short-covering primarily due to the positive close Monday," a broker said.
Pricing at every point higher and long liquidation by the trade capped the move up, he said.
March closed up 0.06 at 10.75, traded narrowly from 10.77 to 10.69. The back months settled 0.03 firmer.
Traders expect activity to thin ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving holiday. The CSCE will be closed Thursday and Friday.
Support remained between 10.50 and 10.48 in March.
